study.question: Can target-conditioned raw count/histogram/identity summaries retain joint_identity validation utility with lower measured cost, and does sensitivity to conditional category-brand pairing persist after removing learned history pooling?
study.hypothesis: The supplied joint_identity result (AUC 0.62042594, training 548.36s, inference 19.2176s) improves over pooled and DIN references but does not identify its mechanism. Its forward graph still performs per-event learned category/brand/action/recency lookups, grouped pooling, independent moments and a global norm readout. Static fields plus exact target-match counts, action-age histograms and conditional identity concentration may suffice on this capped 128-event history. Removing the learned history path should reduce measured cost. A capacity control tests whether failure is explained by fewer active weights. Conditional brand folding tests sensitivity to pairing beyond preserved group marginals; it is only a partial deterministic perturbation, so a null effect cannot establish pairing irrelevance.

nearest_work.difference: Primary nearest local method. Inherit exact count/histogram/identity formulas and residual readout; remove the three learned history blocks rather than add a representation. Parent source and initial candidate SHA256 agree. Only four supplied successful trajectories are authorized; hidden ancestor outcomes, failures and other arms are not inferred.

DIN uses learned candidate-conditioned weighted event pooling. This replacement uses hard category/brand target-match partitions and unlearned exact summaries, with no event attention. The local softmax/summed-field DIN adaptation is not an exact paper reproduction. Author implementation not inspected; no priority claim.

Author README confirms category/brand/type histories lack item IDs. Pair keys here denote supplied bucket pairs, never items. Full publisher paper is unavailable in the authorized cache; no DMR mechanism reproduction or novelty comparison is claimed.

External summaries and QueryFormer attention replacement results motivate checking capacity/cost as confounds, but do not establish transfer to this temporal click task. No industry architecture is adopted. This is a local sufficiency/efficiency study with novelty unverified, not a new priority claim for histograms, entropy, collision statistics or MLPs.

inherited_components: Frozen data identity, causal prefix, first-six-day training coverage, validation scorer, natural class ratio, 3 epochs, batch 4096, history cap 128 and scratch initialization; train seed 42.
Static field embedding dimension 16 and field order; compact cells allocate all static embedding tables first in identical order, retaining their seed initialization.

Exact incumbent four target-match groups, log1p count scaling by log(129), 4x4 action-age histograms with fixed 1h/1d/7d edges, and complete-pair-supported category/brand/pair entropy and collision statistics.
Exact sorted BxL distribution algorithm and bias-free 28-to-16-to-1 identity residual head with zero final weight; all three identity distributions computed in every cell.
Natural host optimizer and loss; no optimizer, loss, sample, label, scorer or protocol modifications.
study.proposed_difference: Replace 176 learned history coordinates (4 pooled vectors, 4 independent diagonal moment vectors, 3 global norm-direction vectors at d=16) by their removal. The base MLP sees only static embeddings plus 68 inherited raw summary coordinates; the unchanged identity head adds the remaining 28. Compare the narrow implementation with an approximately active-parameter-matched wider MLP. Complete the representation-by-pairing 2x2 using matched compact and frozen full reference with identical conditional brand folding. The full intact cell is the existing frozen parent at seed 42; repeat all consequential cells before strong conclusions.
predictions: Predeclared practical retention margin is 0.001 absolute AUC below joint_identity: initial seed-42 screening requires AUC >=0.6194259428 and reporting the unweighted Logloss change. A seed-42 pass alone is preliminary; retained utility requires paired-seed and user-cluster uncertainty where the host exposes it. Prefer mean AUC delta >=-0.001 with a paired 95% user-cluster interval lower bound above -0.001; without this interval do not claim formal noninferiority.

Predeclared cost target is >=10% lower training seconds OR >=10% lower full validation inference seconds relative to a contemporaneous frozen reference under the same host recipe and sample coverage. Report all other cost metrics, including p50/p95 whole-batch latency and peak memory. Historical receipt comparisons are screening evidence until repeated under matched runtime conditions; no FLOP-only efficiency claim.

If narrow misses retention but matched compact recovers it, active parameter allocation is a consequential explanation. If both miss, these summaries fail as a replacement at this recipe; this does not establish that all compression fails.

Pair folding must preserve exact group and complete-pair counts, complete-support category/brand multisets, nonidentity summaries, marginal identity entropies/collisions, and every action/age input. Only joint identity summaries and their readout may change, up to floating reduction tolerance. Report change rates before interpreting a predictive null.

AUC losses under folding in both full and matched compact cells would provisionally support conditional pairing sensitivity in the inherited identity residual. The interaction is (compact_fold-compact_intact)-(reference_fold-reference_intact). Similar seed variation, unchanged joint statistics, or comparable generic perturbation losses would weaken that interpretation. No claim of all event binding being necessary.
falsifiers: Any mask, missing-support, marginal multiset, match-group or action/age preservation failure invalidates the pairing contrast. Require exact integer preservation and float summary error <=1e-4; diagnose before new training if host diagnostics fail.
Failure of both compact cells to meet the AUC retention margin rejects these implementations. Failure of both cost targets rejects the measured efficiency hypothesis even if AUC improves.

If compact capacity matching removes a deficit, fewer weights rather than indispensable history geometry remains viable; if it fails, optimization and shared history embedding supervision still remain alternatives.

A folding null with little joint-statistic change is non-discriminating. Even with a change it cannot refute arbitrary pairing dependence, because the perturbation is deterministic and restricted within already paired target-match groups.

Selective pairing causality is not established without additional analytic empirical-product and generic disruption controls plus repetition; reserve these rather than infer causality from a single score or candidate-supplied 512-row diagnostics.
alternative_explanations: Frozen parent versus new modules differ in output initialization, parameter geometry and gradient exposure of shared static/history tables; active count matching cannot equalize these.
Conditional target-match membership, especially the both-match count, still retains target-related pairing. Folding probes only residual within-group pairing on complete support.
Even/odd folding depends on input rank and need not destroy all dependencies; it may create temporal/order artifacts. Its 512-row checkpoint diagnostics are not population causal evidence.

Removing history lookup removes training exposure for rare category/brand embeddings and all action/recency embeddings. A deficit can reflect embedding supervision as well as loss of learned history information.
Host data gathering, static embedding optimization or sorting may dominate runtime, so removing learned history tensor operations may not provide end-to-end savings.

Three existing baselines and one imported candidate are successful supplied trajectories; no failed/abandoned-branch receipts are supplied. Their absence is missing evidence, not evidence that no failures occurred. Reused validation, a single seed and static snapshot as-of uncertainty limit inference.

Prerequisites are supported by the supplied host contract and successful receipts. Raw physical paths, host execution internals, original preparation manifests and Torch are unavailable in this coding phase; local baseline training or raw-table re-verification was not performed. This is an execution boundary, not a failed model or counterevidence.
